title: Tomato & Chickpea Skillet
description: Chickpeas simmer in a garlicky tomato sauce with spinach; good with bread.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet; cook onion over medium heat for about 5 minutes until softened.
Add garlic and oregano and stir 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas, crushed tomatoes, salt and pepper. Simmer uncovered 10 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted, 2–3 minutes; serve with bread.
